title: remote: unhide --cidfile flag for pause, unpause, restart, and stop
body:
Fixes #25649.

The flag is hidden for remote clients on pause, unpause, restart and stop, but it works there. The client reads the file and sends the resolved ID. This removes the MarkHidden calls and extends the existing `--cidfile` e2e tests to check that `--help` lists the flag.

The e2e tests for pause, unpause, restart and stop now check that `--help` lists the flag. I also built `podman-remote` on macOS and confirmed the flag appears in the help output. The linux suites run in CI.
